dry-run.meaning: Observe connector, card and sink state and report the target without setting the card profile or default sink.

mutationPerformed.meaning: A card-profile or default-sink change was attempted, even if it failed or could not be confirmed.

changed.meaning: A changed card profile or default sink was confirmed by readback.

default_sink_after.meaning: Default sink observed after the attempt or plan, or null when not observed.

skipped.meaning: No HDMI connector was connected; no change was needed.

observed.meaning: Connector statuses, initial card profile, configured sink and initial default sink, when read.

could_change_to.meaning: Selected card, HDMI profile, sink and source of the selection when available.

attempt.meaning: Dry-run flag, optional card-change wait with its own signal, and attempts to set the profile and sink.

final_receipt.meaning: Completion verdict, optional skip or refusal, and profile/sink readback on success.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Present on a refused response; success omits it. The optional card-change wait has its own nested signal, and an invalid canonical dry-run value is intercepted by the front door.

anyOf.meaning: The actual omitted kernel names, joined by commas.
The envelope reader reports the foreign id it found. The front door separately refuses a foreign seat at startup.
